name: nextjs-api-template
description: Next.js API template with folder-based routing, route layout wrapper, middleware, and controlled versioning.

scripts.dev:log: mkdir -p logs && next dev 2>&1 | tee logs/dev.log
scripts.build:log: mkdir -p logs && next build 2>&1 | tee logs/build.log
scripts.start:log: mkdir -p logs && next start 2>&1 | tee logs/start.log
scripts.syntax: node --check middleware.js && node --check lib/api-version.js && node --check lib/route-layout.js && node --check app/layout.js && node --check app/page.js && node --check app/api/v1/health/route.js && node --check app/api/v1/users/route.js && node --check app/api/v1/users/[paramsId]/route.js
